info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Realgar Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Realgar Produce Detail Management API facilitates the integration and creation of detailed catalogs for realgar produce. This endpoint allows users to submit new produce details, ensuring that the catalog remains up to date with the latest offerings. Typical consumers of this API include producers, retailers, and inventory management systems that require accurate, detailed information about realgar produce products. By utilizing this API, users can streamline their product listings and improve inventory accuracy.

post.summary: Create new details for realgar production.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details associated with the realgar production process. Provide the necessary information in the request body to manage and store the details effectively.
